text:
marta: Heads-up — I'm proposing a tier-aware circuit-breaker policy for private customers with strict egress/allowed-region constraints. The idea: avoid cross-region model fallbacks for private tenants; prefer local smaller-variant fallbacks or queue to Dedicated capacity. Thoughts?

samir: agree in principle. main risk is cold starts when local variant isn't warmed. can we prefer cached KV prefixes + small-quantized variant before routing out?

lin: important: for VPC private control plane, egress to other regions is blocked by policy for some customers. any automatic routing that crosses allowed_regions must be explicit opt-in in tenant config (consent + audit).

olivia: +1 on consent. UX asks: how do we surface in console when a request is served by a fallback variant vs routed to hosted? need clear telemetry and billing labels.

alex: Console mock: add a per-tenant 'fallback policy' card. shows priority order (local_variant -> cached_small_variant -> dedicated_pool -> blocked). Also show counts and last-10 sample request IDs. quick mock:

```
fallback_policy:
  - type: local_variant
    allowed: true
  - type: cached_quantized
    allowed: true
    max_latency_ms: 200
  - type: dedicated_pool
    allowed: true
  - type: cross-region_hosted
    allowed: false
```

jean: question: how do we handle quotas? If we divert to dedicated_pool that eats customer's reserved capacity, we need clear cost attribution and quota checks or automatic deny if no capacity.

marta: exactly. proposal: tie circuit-breaker thresholds to tier and quota. For 'enterprise' tier allow dedicated_pool fallback if reserve_available>0. For 'self-serve' tier, prefer cached_quantized and otherwise return 429 with a structured error indicating fallback options.

samir: also: we should implement soft-sampling / telemetry flag so we can measure quality delta when quantized fallback is used. capture a small % of requests for golden run to measure regressions.

lin: security requirement: any fallback that would egress to hosted must generate a signed access log and require tenant opt-in. no silent egress.

olivia: for rollout plan: start with internal-only tenants (staging), enable telemetry + mock console, then 2-week canary on small enterprise tenants with opt-in, then wider rollout.

alex: UX note: add a toggle for 'allow_cross_region_fallback' with hover tooltip listing legal/contract implications.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature-branch 'tier-cb-fallback' will land in staging at 2024-11-17T03:00Z :rocket:

marta: action items:
- @samir: prototype runtime policy eval and metrics hooks
- @alex: console card + toggle mock
- @lin: draft opt-in audit wording + signed-log schema
- @olivia: rollout playbook + billing label mapping
- @jean: quota rules + reserved-capacity checks

samir: starting a branch. will post minimal config schema in the thread when ready.

marta: thanks — please keep short status updates here. :thumbsup:
